videos.title: Pompeii 79 AD: The Day Vesuvius Buried a Living City
videos.description:
I have always been haunted by Pompeii, not by the volcano itself, but by the ordinary morning it destroyed. People were baking bread, planning weddings, and packing for voyages, never knowing the mountain above them was about to explode.

This is the dramatic true story of the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD: the seventeen-year-old boy whose letters are our only eyewitness account, his heroic uncle who sailed into the ash cloud to save strangers, and the city that was frozen in time for nearly two thousand years.
